boundary: Guidance only. Do not substitute TOD/Codex implementation for MIM execution.
immediate_guidance: Acknowledge the objective in MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS.latest.json before attempting broad implementation.
Run a bounded sensor inventory from the active MIM runtime context and publish MIM_LAB_SENSOR_INVENTORY.latest.json.
Cycle each camera one at a time, including the arm camera only through existing safe capture/scan routines, and publish MIM_LAB_CAMERA_CYCLE_STATUS.latest.json.
When a human presence signal is available, initiate TTS and store the interaction summary in MIM_HUMAN_INTERACTION_MEMORY.latest.json.
Record Dave as primary_operator only as an identity/memory binding; do not claim face/person recognition until verified.
For visible unknown objects, publish an inquiry item in MIM_OBJECT_MEMORY_AND_INQUIRY.latest.json instead of guessing labels.
blocked_if: No camera/mic access from runtime context.
Arm camera capture path unsafe or unavailable.
No active watcher consumes shared objective artifacts.
required_blocked_response: If blocked, publish the exact blocked_if reason, evidence, and next repair objective. Do not stay silent.
not_success_until: Dave/human presence is detected or explicitly marked unavailable with evidence.
MIM emits TTS acknowledgement or publishes a precise TTS blocker.
All five required artifacts exist and contain current evidence.
A repeat observation shows MIM can continue without Codex doing the work.
